date: 2026-05-19
title: "Thoughts About the Roles of AI for Statistics"
description: "This talk covers what I've learned from using large language models in my work for the past two years.  For statistical programming, success has come when I play the role of specification writer and comprehensive tester.  For statistical methodology, AI has been successful serving me as a mathematical statistical assistant and a critic.  Instead of avoiding AI we should embrace it, but we should always set a higher bar for the quality of our work as a result."
categories: [2026, AI, computing]
